chapters.title: Welcome to the RNG-Hellscape
chapters.goal: Introduce Artie and his broken 'Crit-Only' status in a high-stakes environment.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie goes from an office drone to a level 1 glitch in a lethal game world.

bridge.to_next: Artie must find a way to survive his first night with zero defensive stats.

sections.title: The Exit Interview
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and sudden, absurd death.
sections.end_condition: Artie is locked into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Critical Hit rate.

scenes.summary: Artie argues with a vending machine over a bag of chips before a freak electrical surge sends him to the great login screen in the sky.

scenes.transition_out_text: The world dissolves into a blinding white flash as the electrical surge hits.

scenes.summary: The System, personified as a snarky UI, mocks Artie's life choices while he accidentally dumps all his points into the 'Crit' stat.
scenes.outcome: Artie is locked into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Critical Hit rate.
scenes.location_start: A vast, white digital expanse filled with floating screens.
